items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: I've got for about 5 copies of Schönberg, you know, when he did - well, I can't remember names, but it was very inspiring to write music.

ctx.x: Delius or Schönberg. I have a lot of don't ask me to name it all - in the closet. After a while a musician knew what I was doing and he stole them. I've got for about 5 copies of Schönberg, you know, when he did - well, I can't remember names, but it was very inspiring to write music. I'd either do that or play something or help him with the arrangement.
But in order to get yourself in the mood, you played records, is that right?
